data.action: 弯腰涉水双手泼洒晶莹溪水，比基尼勾勒曼妙身材，水珠飞溅，神采奕奕
data.camera: cowboy shot, dynamic water splashing foreground, action depth
data.description: 【常陆茉子 · 幽谷清溪的碧波逐浪】穗织镇后山竹林环抱的山涧溪流边，清泉击石，水花飞溅。茉子身着一袭墨绿相间的运动分体泳装，修长健美的大腿毫无防备地浸在清凉的泉水中。她弯下腰双手捧起冰凉甘甜的溪水向镜头泼洒，水珠在灿烂阳光下化作剔透的水帘，丰满诱人的胸线在微湿的布料下若隐若现。
data.lighting: 茂密竹林间透射下的直射烈日与水面跳跃的焦散光斑
data.location: 竹林深处山涧清澈溪流卵石滩
data.promptProse: Mako bends at the mountain stream to scoop cool water in both hands and splash it toward the camera. Her forest-green-and-black athletic swimsuit and cropped mesh cover-up remain clear behind the cowboy-shot foreground droplets. Bare feet stand among smooth stones, with dense bamboo surrounding the channel behind. Direct sunlight through the canopy catches the spray and water surface, while moving reflections brighten the shaded stones beside her ankles.
data.title: 常陆茉子 · 幽谷清溪的碧波逐浪
